Problem Description
: Missing converter in DC2
Troubleshooting
: Please proceed to order a new converter and CAN cables. First test you must do is, confirm if the cables have no problem
Swap this faulty converter with a neighbour one
If the error persists in the same converter please replace it.
If the error is now on the working converter that means that the CAN cables are faulty.
